sources.title: stunmuffin/TinyTurk-v2.7d-bigstories · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TinyTurk v2.7d BigStories is a 1.12M-parameter Turkish causal language model, trained from scratch on a 49,000-story subset of the Turkish TinyStories dataset. It produces fluent, grammatically correct Turkish sentences but does not maintain long-range narrative coherence due to the 128-token context window.
